title: A Positive Mass Theorem for Continuous Metrics
summary: Let $g$ be a continuous metric on $\mathbb R^3$ which is asymptotically flat in the sense that $\vert g_{ij}(x) - δ_{ij}\vert = O(\vert x\vert^{-τ})$ for some $τ> \frac{1}{2}$. Further assume that $g$ can be uniformly approximated on compact sets by smooth metrics with almost non-negative scalar curvature. For such a metric $g$, we define a synthetic ADM mass $m(g)$ using harmonic functions. The harmonic mass $m(g)$ coincides with the usual ADM mass whenever $g$ is smooth and decays rapidly enough that the latter is defined.
